title: Elizabeth Warren Plans Prediction Market Crackdown as She Prepares to Chair Senate Banking
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Elizabeth Warren Plans Prediction Market Crackdown as She Prepares to Chair Senate Banking A Warren banking aide says the incoming Senate Banking chair will target prediction markets' "Wild West-style lack of oversight," after she and Sen. John Curtis pressed Kalshi and Polymarket on election trading. This post Elizabeth Warren Plans Prediction Market Crackdown as She Prepares to Chair Senate Banking first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
